project.name: novim-custom
project.purpose: A terminal-first novim derivative for focused repository navigation, code inspection, and local Git review.

openDecisions.question: Should the first write-capable Git surface be limited to local stage, unstage, and commit with a user-entered message?
openDecisions.recommended: Yes. Keep push, pull, merge, rebase, branch checkout, discard, amend, and remote synchronization out of scope until separately authorized.

openDecisions.question: When a history commit is selected, which comparison should the Diff panes show?
openDecisions.recommended: Show the selected commit versus its first parent; keep a separate Working Tree entry for the current working-tree-versus-HEAD diff, without checking out anything.

openDecisions.question: Should the bottom history show the full commit ancestry graph reachable from the current branch or a first-parent merge timeline?
openDecisions.recommended: Show the full reachable ancestry with merge nodes and branch/decorate labels, while keeping the view read-only.

acceptedProductDirection.layout: Files view: left lazy project tree plus right source preview; Diff view: left changed-file list plus middle old-file and right new-file panes
acceptedProductDirection.paneResize: mouse-draggable, width-constrained boundaries between visible panes
acceptedProductDirection.diffBaseline: working tree versus HEAD, including untracked files

successorBrief.paneGeometry: Persist independent Files and Git Diff layouts across view switches and local workbench launches.
successorBrief.settingsInteraction: Use a visible selected-control cursor; Up/Down changes controls, Left/Right changes theme only on the theme control, Space activates the selected control, Esc closes, and a top-right mouse close control is visible.
successorBrief.sourceControl: Split the left Git area horizontally with current changes/status above and current-branch commit/merge history below; selecting history remains read-only until comparison semantics are confirmed.
successorBrief.localGitWrites: Proposed stage/unstage and local staged commit with a commit-message input; exact mutation boundary is pending GIT-MUTATION-BOUNDARY.
